page.overview:
Who is Crow?

Crow is a rank within Tekken Force, the private military of the Mishima Zaibatsu. It refers to several characters in the Tekken series. Crow, as a single player, appears in Tekken Card Challenge, a non-canonical Tekken game. All that is known of them is their rank with no name given. In the Tekken 3 Tekken Force (Mode), Crows are revealed to be the lowest rank within Tekken Force, with higher ranks being Hawk, Falcon, and Owl.

Crow, along with other soldiers, appears as an enemy character in Tekken Force Mode. Crow can also be made playable via a third-party cheat device in Tekken 3 alongside every other enemy character.

Crow makes an official playable debut in Tekken Card Challenge as an unlockable character.

In Tekken Bowl, if the player scores a Strike, the two characters will celebrate with their win poses, and, in the background, there will be a number of Crow-rank soldiers clapping. Some Crows will be armed with guns while others are not, all of them will be cheering for the player who got a strike.
